shortDescription: Indian Oil Corp NSE:IOC on Monday said it will invest 24.49 billion rupees ($255.6 million) for building and operating a natural gas pipeline between Kochi and Thoothukudi in the southern state of Kerala.($1 = 95.8200 Indian rupees)
